task_context.problem_statement: A pen costs $9 more than a pencil. If a pencil costs $2, find the total cost of both items.
task_context.reference_solution:
A pen costs $9 more than $2 which is $9+$2 = $<<9+2=11>>11
Altogether they cost $11+$2 = $<<11+2=13>>13
#### 13
